nodes.description: Public mapping storing token balances; mutated unchecked in transferFrom and batchSend.
Nested public mapping of spender allowances; written in approve and decremented in transferFrom.
Total token supply set once in the constructor.
Privileged owner address assigned from msg.sender in the constructor; used in delegate/batchSend guards.
Constant Uniswap v2 router address used as allowed pool in the SwapAndFarmingForGarDeners modifier.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom using msg.sender as sender.
Public payable transfer guarded by the SwapAndFarmingForGarDeners modifier; performs unchecked allowance and balance subtractions.
Public payable approval granting the same _value to nine hardcoded role addresses from msg.sender.
Public payable function that executes an arbitrary delegatecall after a role-based require check.
Public payable multi-transfer that computes total = _value * length, subtracts it from the caller and credits each recipient in a loop.
Constructor of ERC20Detailed storing name, symbol and decimals.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks, transfer ownership and role assignment.
Arbitrary low-level a.delegatecall(b) allowing the caller to run foreign code in this contract's storage context.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total unchecked subtraction in batchSend (Solidity 0.5 has no built-in overflow checks).
uint total = _value * _Converts.length unchecked multiplication that can overflow and bypass the balance requirement.
allowance[_Load][msg.sender] -= _value unchecked subtraction in transferFrom.
Local variable holding _value * _Converts.length in batchSend.
Caller-supplied amount parameter used in transfer, transferFrom, approve and batchSend.
Recipient address parameter of transfer.
Sender address parameter of transferFrom.
Arbitrary target contract address passed to delegate and used as delegatecall destination.
Arbitrary calldata bytes forwarded to the delegatecall.
Array of recipient addresses iterated in batchSend.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the sender argument for transfer, letting the caller move their own or authorized funds.
transfer forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender, _Convert, _value).
msg.sender drives the allowance check and subtraction inside transferFrom.
delegate authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender against owner and role addresses.
batchSend authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender against owner and role addresses.
Constructor assigns owner and initial balance from msg.sender.
Caller-supplied address a is the target of the delegatecall, enabling execution of arbitrary code.
Caller-supplied bytes b is the calldata passed to the delegatecall.
delegate performs the low-level delegatecall to an attacker-controlled target.
batchSend executes the unchecked balance subtraction for the caller.
batchSend computes the unchecked product of _value and recipient array length.
Array length of the caller-supplied _Converts array multiplies _value and can overflow.
_value is multiplied by the array length without overflow protection.
Overflowed local total is subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender].
State variable balanceOf is written with the unchecked subtraction result.
transferFrom executes the unchecked allowance subtraction.
State variable allowance is decremented by _value without SafeMath.
_value participates in the unchecked total used for the balance subtraction.
msg.sender indexes the balanceOf mapping modified by the unchecked subtraction.
msg.sender is the spender key whose allowance is decremented unchecked.
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: Local accumulator total only feeds the unchecked balanceOf subtraction in batchSend.
Amount parameter is the operand of the unchecked multiplication and subsequent balance/allowance updates.
Recipient parameter belongs to the transfer function that forwards to transferFrom.
Sender parameter belongs to transferFrom where allowance and balance are debited.
Target address parameter is the delegatecall destination in the unsafe operation.
Calldata parameter is supplied to the delegatecall in the unsafe operation.
Recipient array parameter is iterated by batchSend for the multi-transfer loop.
